review_scope: Independent source review of the panel-context diagnostic and focused source checks; no hosted or native browser run.

verdicts.A_source_readiness: PASS: The diagnostic is safe to collect on a controlled hosted guest run. Native behavior and Store acceptance remain unverified.
verdicts.B_quality: PASS: The counters distinguish an empty result from several mismatch classes without changing the pass criterion. They do not establish root cause on their own.

evidence.exact_match: requireSidePanelContext still requires contextType SIDE_PANEL, the exact panel URL, and tabId -1. The new count runs only in its failure catch and rethrows the original error.
evidence.single_query: The initial path still makes one sidePanelContexts call. Its Runtime.evaluate asks chrome.runtime.getContexts for SIDE_PANEL contexts and rejects non-array or exception results before the new diagnostic runs.
evidence.deadlines: The change did not alter waitForPanelTarget, waitForSettledGuestPanel, retry counts, or wait intervals.
evidence.ownership_and_resources: The change did not alter CDP/profile/extension ownership checks, the hosted resource guard, or the finally cleanup that detaches CDP and stops only the spawned child.
evidence.log_safety: The new line contains only six integer counts; no URLs, context identifiers, arbitrary tab IDs, or exception text are serialized.

limits: The focused test checks the counter helper with empty and mixed arrays, but does not execute the integrated stderr failure path in a native browser.
Counts may narrow a mismatch yet cannot prove timing, Chrome registration, or an extension defect; the next controlled hosted observation is required.
No runtime evidence was generated in this review, and no guest Scrape case was observed.
